title: 河洛群俠傳 (Ho Tu Lo Shu ： The Books of Dragon)
provenance: Reported by w8079 (highball-db#397, 2026-10-08), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-crossover26.3-r19, the environment in DXMT mode, rated 4 of 5 after about 9 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on DXMT, the default mode, over about 9 minutes on an M4: 23 fps in the opening village at 1920x1080 and 30 at 1600x900, steady, with no stutter. The interface and subtitles are Chinese only. Unity 2019.3, 64-bit, Direct3D 11. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: About 23 fps at 1920x1080 on an M4
knownIssues.cause: the frame rate follows the resolution, so the GPU is the limit at that size (the reporter's measurement)
knownIssues.fix: Lower the resolution in the game's video settings: 1600x900 gave about 30 fps.
